pet_deposit.reason: The property states "Pet deposit is 150 USD" and never states whether it is refundable. A deposit that is returned and one that is not are different charges, and the word "deposit" alone does not establish which this is.

columbus-oh|days inn by wyndham columbus.note: The legacy record inferred refundability from the field NAME and the page rendered "a separate refundable pet deposit of $150" -- a promise the property never made. Under 1.2 refundability must be explicit, so the amount is withheld with its reason instead of being published with an invented guarantee.

columbus-oh|drury inn and suites columbu.quote: limit two pets per room with a combined weight of 80 pounds service animals free of charge
columbus-oh|drury inn and suites columbu.note: The 80 pounds is the two pets TOGETHER -- the property's own sentence says "combined weight of 80 pounds". The legacy record stored it in weight_limit with no operator, and the renderer recovered the word "combined" by reading the evidence text at render time. Writing it as a per-pet maximum would publish an 80-pound allowance per animal that the property never granted, so it moves to combined_weight_limit where the field name carries the scope. The same sentence states service animals are free of charge.
